title: eludite.editor.insert_snippet input
description: Insert a code snippet at the caret (Edit > IntelliSense > Insert Snippet, Ctrl+K, Ctrl+X; brief 0069). With `shortcut`, the snippet of that shortcut in the document's language is inserted as a snippet session (Tab and Shift+Tab move between its fields; Enter or Escape ends it); without one, the Insert Snippet picker opens.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.

shortcut.description: The snippet's shortcut (`prop`, `ctor`, `cw`), as eludite.editor.snippets lists it.
